# vendor/qrcode.js

`qrcode.js` — QR Code Generator for JavaScript, v2.0.4
Copyright (c) 2009 Kazuhiko Arase · MIT License
https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator

Vendored (not loaded from a CDN) so the page works offline and has no runtime
third-party dependency. The library only encodes text into QR modules; it makes
no network calls.
